title: STRANDMON armchair and ottoman
description: STRANDMON armchair and ottoman, Grann/Bomstad dark brown STRANDMON has a timeless look with modern comfort for many cozy moments. The wing chair offers a soft embracing feel and the footstool is nice to rest your feet on – or use as extra seating for guests.
features: Grain leather is treated with a light protective surface coating to retain its natural look with marks, wrinkles and color variations. Therefore it´s also less resistant to sunlight, dirt, liquids and scratches than leather with a thick surface treatment
The armchair and footstool come in separate packages.
The seat cushion, back rest and inside of the armrests are covered with GRANN – a soft, smooth and strong grain leather with natural variations. Other surfaces have the coated fabric BOMSTAD.
The top cushion is covered with GRANN – a soft, smooth and strong grain leather with natural variations. Other surfaces have the coated fabric BOMSTAD.
materialAndCare: Leather: Dyed through top-grain leather with a treated, embossed and pigmented surface; Coated fabric parts: 100 % polyurethane, 75 % polyester, 25 % cotton; Frame: Plywood, Polyurethane foam 1.2 lb/cu.ft., Polyurethane foam 1.5 lb/cu.ft., Polyurethane foam 2.2 lb/cu.ft., Particleboard, Solid wood, Fiberboard; Seat cushion: Polyurethane foam 2.2 lb/cu.ft., Polyurethane foam, Polyurethane foam 1.2 lb/cu.ft.; Leg: Solid beech; Leather: Dyed through top-grain leather with a treated, embossed and pigmented surface; Coated fabric parts: 100 % polyurethane, 75 % polyester, 25 % cotton; Frame: 100% polyester (min. 70% recycled), Particleboard, Plywood, Polyurethane foam 1.5 lb/cu.ft.; Cushion: 100% polyester (min. 70% recycled), Polyurethane foam 1.5 lb/cu.ft., Polyurethane foam 2.0 lb/cu.ft.; Leg: Solid wood, Tinted lacquer
